patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-contrast black and white photography and video are used as dominant content blocks, creating a strong visual impact.
A predominantly monochromatic color scheme (black, white, various greys) is used throughout, with a single dark, muted accent color for the footer background.

The hero section features a large, full-bleed image/video that exhibits a subtle parallax effect, where the foreground subject scrolls at a slightly different rate than the background, creating a sense of depth.
Minimalist sans-serif typography is used consistently for all text, characterized by generous letter spacing for navigation and headings, contributing to an airy and refined feel.
Product categories are introduced through large, distinct, full-width image sections, often presented in a split layout with two prominent images side-by-side.

technique_notes: The site employs a custom smooth scrolling experience, likely using `locomotive-scroll`, which enables a subtle parallax effect on the hero image/video. This effect causes foreground elements to move slower than the background as the user scrolls, enhancing visual depth and engagement.
Full-bleed hero sections utilize high-resolution video or static imagery, often in black and white, to immediately establish a strong brand aesthetic and visual mood.
Content sections are structured with large, responsive image blocks that adapt to fill the width, often presenting two distinct product visuals side-by-side to introduce categories.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are clean sans-serif, moderately sized, and often uppercase, while body text is small and legible, maintaining an airy feel.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — generous whitespace around major sections and within navigation elements creates a premium, uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of large-scale, high-contrast black and white photography and video creates a strong editorial and artistic feel, elevating the product presentation beyond typical e-commerce. The subtle, smooth parallax scrolling adds a premium, immersive touch that makes the content feel dynamic and engaging.
